_comment: Template for the hackathon submission. Copy to submission.local.json, which is gitignored,
and fill in the empty values. Every one of them is YK's decision: nothing here is generated.
Then run `pnpm submit` to validate and print the payload, and `pnpm submit --send` to send it
after reading it. docs/SUBMISSION.md records which values are already decided and why.
requestId is added by the script on first run and then kept, so a retry is the same
application rather than a second one. Do not fill it in by hand.
